description.value: Coal Creek Camp and RV is a developed campground and RV park located along Coal Creek Road in the Montane area of Fernie, BC, developed by Parastone Developments. It offers tent sites and RV hookups adjacent to scenic nature trails, with Coal Creek running directly beside the property. The campground is walking distance from Historic Downtown Fernie.

address.value: 120 Coal Creek Rd, Fernie, BC V0B 1M2, Canada

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully readable and provides strong evidence. The FAQ explicitly confirms potable water at each RV site, restroom facilities with showers and toilets, tent sites, and online-only reservations. The contact page provides the address (120 Coal Creek Rd, Fernie, BC V0B 1M2) and phone (250-531-0016). The OSM name 'Coal Creek Camping & RV' differs slightly from the website name 'Coal Creek Camp and RV'; OSM name is retained per rules but flagged. No OSM tags were present to cross-check amenity claims against.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM uses 'Coal Creek Camping & RV' but website consistently uses 'Coal Creek Camp and RV'.
OSM record has no tags at all (no osm_id, no address, no phone) — candidate appears to be a manual addition with no OSM node backing it.
Phone listed on website is described as 'Camp Host: daytime only' with email as the preferred contact method.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly bookable campground in Fernie, BC with a functioning website, confirmed amenities, and online reservations.
